"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先把尾部恒流源算清楚</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>变化点在尾部：先由稳压管与 V3 确定恒流源，再用对称性把电流分到 V1、V2。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求稳压支路 → 求尾电流 → 对称均分 → 求 Q → 再做差模动态</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>题目若明确要求计入 R_B，就不能沿用忽略基极电流的简化。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>尾部含稳压管时，先判断稳压管是否真的进入稳压区；静态电流错了，后面的增益会全错。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>按卷面手写解答：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">I<sub>C3</sub>≈1 mA，U<sub>CEQ1</sub>≈5.22 V，A<sub>ud,双</sub>≈−285.6。</span></p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第7题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">电流源</span><span class="tag">双端输出</span><span class="tag">A<sub>ud</sub></span><span class="tag">R<sub>id</sub></span></div></div><div class="score">12 分 · 综合验收</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 B卷 第7题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>参考电流 → Q 点 → 双端增益 → 输入电阻</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>先由参考支路确定电流源，再利用对称性求静态点；动态部分继续处理双端差模输出和差模输入电阻。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求参考电流 → 求尾电流 → 对称均分 → 双端差模增益 → 差模输入电阻</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>静态、电流源、动态三部分要分开写，步骤分会更稳。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>参考电流、支路电流和差模输入电阻按顺序算；R<sub>id</sub> 别和单边输入电阻混淆。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>按卷面解答：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">I<sub>REF</sub>≈1.47 mA，I<sub>CQ</sub>≈0.735 mA，A<sub>ud</sub>≈−208.9，R<sub>id</sub>≈9.572 kΩ。</span></p></div></details></div></div></article>
